form:FormGroup.label: Search type
form:FormGroup.helpText: Where to look in the output. All text tests every element. XPath tests only the nodes selected by an XPath expression. Default is All text.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: All text tests every element; XPath tests selected nodes. Default is All text.

form:FormGroup.label: XPath
form:FormGroup.helpText: An XPath expression that selects the nodes to test, e.g. //Event/EventDetail/User/Id. Elements in the output's default namespace need no prefix.

form:FormGroup.label: Condition
form:FormGroup.helpText: How the selected nodes are tested: Exists, Does not exist, Contains, Does not contain, Equals or Not equals. Unique values stops at each record with a value not seen before. Default is Exists.

form:FormGroup.label: Value
form:FormGroup.helpText: The text to compare with the selected nodes. For Equals and Not equals, numeric and boolean XPath results are compared as values rather than text.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Text to compare with the selected nodes.
